limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Greece-Israel $1.1B weapons deal and Israel David's Sling upgrade are verified state procurement moves; UK Ukraine drone/missile deals and Turkey-Somalia defense ties add order flow.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Flash PMI gauge and Australian PMI/jobs shock give concrete growth momentum signals; IMF Hungary upgrade and US consumer-spending focus are market-relevant.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Houthi-attack-driven oil price moves, Iranian smuggling sanctions, India import-bill surge, Qatar LNG priority and Norway winter gas are material supply/price signals; pipeline incident is verified disruption.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Only distinct verifiable stress items; collateral/orbital-asset risk and microfinance contraction are notable but thin corroboration.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: State Medicaid work-requirement delay and CMS Medicare Advantage measure cuts are concrete policy changes; FDA approvals are verified but mostly single-company.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Strait of Hormuz escalation is the key global-transmission threat; Trump/Iran strike threats and Houthi/Saudi attacks affect energy; settler sanctions and Ukraine strikes are corroborated cross-border state actions.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: SNB hike signal and gold/silver rout tied to Fed repricing are highest-recency material moves; US inflation data and global growth outlook are asset-relevant.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: USGS-confirmed M6.7 Peru and M6.5 Vanuatu quakes are verifiable shocks; Florida flood emergency and government-shutdown risk have market relevance.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold/silver weekly crash on Fed repricing is the dominant verified move; China gold imports surplus and Hezbollah-linked smuggling sanctions are material flow events.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Nvidia China export-control probe is the largest technology-policy risk; new US chip rules forcing Southeast Asian alignment and data-center power/permitting signals have broad supply-chain implications.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: US-Canada tariff relief talks and EU-Indonesia pact are major supply-chain events; export-control gap and EU-China car tariff signals add policy risk.
